features.title: Automatic bottleneck identification

features.title: Intelligent drill generation
acceptance: Skill-cell drills launch from the heatmap cell detail and the due-review queue (Train tab) and run as mode 'drill' with pinned operand ranges, id 'pattern-drill' and an honest explanation; results never upgrade to benchmark (benchmarkEquivalent false, pinned); daily plan surfaces the weakest stable pattern when its data exists; difficulty tiers are F18, cross-operation pattern mixes and efficacy evaluation (F21/F22) are separate features and remain out of scope here

features.title: Adaptive difficulty
acceptance: Pattern drills have three difficulty tiers (Narrow = lower half of each band, Full = the exact cell and the default, Stretch = full cell plus exactly one adjacent band on one axis, capped at the benchmark operand space for the four double-top cells); the tier is chosen across runs from the F19 review record's success streak (0 = Narrow, 1-3 or no usable evidence = Full, >= 4 = Stretch), never mid-run, so one run's generated pool and per-run review stay interpretable; tier-1/2 draws map to exactly the drilled cell and a stretch interleaves exactly its two adjacent cells (both occur in seeded draws); every tier stays practice-only (id 'pattern-drill', benchmarkEquivalent false, benchmark ruleset untouched); explicitly out of scope: in-run difficulty adaptation, cross-operation pattern mixes (the generator draws from one rectangle per operation), calibrated mastery modeling and any efficacy claim (F21/F22)

features.title: Spaced repetition
acceptance: Pure scheduling primitive is deterministic with explicit now; per-skill review records persist in IndexedDB schema v2 (additive store) with capped localStorage fallback, sanitized/versioned imports and v2 export bundle; every completed pattern drill records one review (interrupted or under-3-solve runs record nothing) whose success rule is at least half the run's in-cell solves at or under the shared AUTOMATICITY_MS 2000 line (nearest-rank median, pinned edge by edge); a due-review queue on the Train tab prompts at-or-overdue records and launches their cells; review outcomes measure speed only (the engine does not persist wrong attempts) and the 1-60 day ladder is a heuristic, not a validated model

features.title: Cognitive automaticity training
acceptance: Automaticity ('flash') drill on any heatmap cell: engine-enforced per-question latency budget (questionBudgetMs, default the shared AUTOMATICITY_MS 2000 line; slow questions record as missedEvents, never scored, next question gets a fresh window), seeded generator wrapped in varyStimulus so no fact repeats back to back (avoids rote sequence recall; degenerate single-fact ranges cap redraws instead of hanging), stage 'flash' pinned so flash runs never write spaced-repetition reviews, benchmark ruleset byte-identical and imported sessions unaffected

features.title: Weakness gauntlet
acceptance: Gauntlet plan (packages/training/src/gauntlet.js) selects at most two skill cells per day that clear the sample gate with shrunken ratio > 1 (weakest first, deterministic, never a sub-gate or fast cell), drills each with the F18 tier ladder on random seeds, probes each family with fresh same-range problems from a day-scoped seed that is never the training seed and a varyStimulus generator, hands off to one standard benchmark; every stage is a practice ruleset (benchmarkEquivalent false, pinned byte-identity of BENCHMARK_RULES) and 'Play again' relaunches the stage; explicit out-of-scope: efficacy claims and in-run adaptation (F21/F22)
